verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own multi-environment model. Flags can be toggled per environment, environments are unlimited, production can be locked down with RBAC, and release pipelines promote flags to production. It also documents running a full Flagsmith environment locally in Docker, so a user or agent can work in a non-production environment. The docs never explicitly describe environments as isolated sandboxes, and per-environment data separation is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation that non-production environments isolate production data, sandbox or test-environment guidance for agent/MCP workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
